name: relationship-lens
description: Relationship Lens: a light-glass Salesforce client-relationship page published as a live artifact. Reads Account, Opportunity, Case and Contact through the connected sObject MCP, creates cases from inside the page (AI-drafted via the viewer's Claude, or plain fields), and manages the case lifecycle in plain language: close, reopen, escalate, reprioritize. One connector only: sObject read/write.
